title: Grammar Detective
summary: Investigate broken 'case file' sentences with a highlighter pen, word cards and readable verdicts.
mobileSupportNote: Full learning loop works at 390x844 (verified live): stacked case rows with chevron open-cues, tap marking, ◀ ▶ card buttons as the primary reorder path (HTML5 drag is desktop-mouse only by design). Longer explanation memos scroll vertically on phone.

cover.alt: Staged real moment on the live app: case file 'The Sleepy Witness' mid-investigation — 'dog' and 'garden' inked with the yellow NOUN highlighter pen with NOUN chips under them, clue 1 open in its yellow strip, NOUN pen active in the tray

desktop.alt: Honest default landing: the case board — Grammar Detective masthead with bureau seal, 0/12 cases resolved counter, three manila dossier folders (FILE A Naming Words & Action Words, FILE B The Word Order Desk, FILE C The Review Vault) with index-card case rows

tablet.alt: Hero tablet view of the evidence screen: 'The Sleepy Witness' case sheet with the sentence under investigation (dotted-baseline tappable words), NOUN pen tray, three clue buttons (1 open, 2 and 3 locked) and the cobalt 'File verdict' button — fits the viewport with no scrolling

mobile.alt: Honest mobile landing: the case board stacked vertically at 390px — masthead, 0/12 progress, FILE A folder with case rows (chevron open cues)
